description:
Provisioned multi-cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure) with Terraform modules and Ansible across 80+ instances and EKS clusters, cutting environment setup from 2 hours to 30 min.
Owned 35+ P1/P2 escalations as the technical contact for client issues, including a site-wide outage: led the response with the application vendor, completed RCA, and drove recurrence to zero over 6 months, earning direct customer appreciation. 
Standardized GitOps CI/CD (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Helm) for 10+ application teams, automating release management and rolling deployments to Amazon EKS with zero downtime. 
Monitored application health and system performance across 40+ production application stacks leveraging Grafana and the ELK Stack, proactively investigating alerts and resolving performance bottlenecks to ensure strict SLA compliance. 
Spearheaded release management for mission-critical platform migrations and infrastructure lifecycle upgrades across 10+production application stacks, orchestrating blue/green failover testing to maintain 99.9% uptime during major OS transitions. 
Resolved production incidents in a 24/7 on-call rotation across 40+ applications, driving troubleshooting and root-cause analysis (RCA) and authoring 20+ runbooks with QA and Knowledge Management that cut repeated escalations by 40%. 
Orchestrated enterprise access management and full credential/certificate lifecycles (password rotation, license updates, SSL renewals) for 40+ applications via CyberArk and Active Directory integration, achieving zero expiry-related outages. 
Automated system maintenance and health checks using Python and Bash, reducing manual triage effort by 30%.
